items.title: 4.2 Choosing the Right Data Structure for the Problem (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of choosing a data structure (PDF 116-117).

blocks.text: Computer science aur programming mein masle hal karte waqt sahi data structure chunna bohat zaroori hai. Har data structure alag qisam ke masle ke liye suitable (theek) hota hai. Yeh samajhna ke kaunsa kab istemal karna hai, aap ke hal ko zyada efficient (tez aur kam kharch) aur banane mein aasan bana deta hai. Aaiye dekhein ke paanch data structures, Stack, Queue, List, Tree aur Graph, mein se har ek kab sab se behtar hai.

blocks.prompt: Kis situation (soorat) ke liye graph data structure sab se behtar hai (MCQ 10)?
blocks.explanation: (c) Social network mein connections dikhana. To-do list ke liye list aur dukaan mein gahakon ki qataar ke liye queue behtar hai.

items: Masle ke mutabiq structure chunein: stack, queue, list, tree ya graph.
